course.name: BM BS Medicine (A100)
course.notes: Standard-entry A100 route. KMMS sorts applicants into Groups A-E before Stage 1/2; graduates applying to A100 are handled through Group D rather than a separate A101 course.

medical_school.provider: Jointly delivered by Canterbury Christ Church University and the University of Kent

applicant_pools.label: Group A
applicant_pools.definition: Pre-A-level or pre-IB applicants with English or Welsh school performance data.
applicant_pools.stage2b: GCSE attainment contextualised against school GCSE performance data, including Attainment 8 where available.
manual_review_if: school performance data not held by ApplySmart
school has no usable contextualisation data and applicant must be rerouted to Group C

applicant_pools.label: Group B
applicant_pools.definition: Post-A-level or post-IB applicants, including gap-year applicants and applicable final-year degree applicants.
applicant_pools.stage2b: Achieved post-16 attainment contextualised against school performance, including percentage achieving AAB+ where available.

applicant_pools.label: Group C
applicant_pools.definition: Applicants whose school data cannot be contextualised in the Group A/B manner, including Scottish, Northern Irish, home-educated, Access to HE Medicine, Home-fee international-secondary and no-usable-school-data applicants.
applicant_pools.stage2b: Separate scoring and possible CASPer/manual review.

applicant_pools.label: Group D
applicant_pools.definition: Graduates with a relevant achieved degree.
applicant_pools.stage2b: Graduate scoring and possible CASPer/manual review.

applicant_pools.label: Group E
applicant_pools.stage2b: International applicants are scored separately from Home applicants and may have remote MMI/CASPer handling.

overall_policy.description: Stage 1 is a strict academic threshold using the appropriate achieved qualification for the resolved applicant group. Predicted grades are not used at any stage.
not_eligible_if: Minimum GCSE, achieved A-level/IB, Access, Scottish, degree or verified international-equivalence requirements are not met for the applicable group.
Graduate route SJT Band 3 or Band 4.

accepted_equivalencies: Double Science at 66 plus one other GCSE at grade 6/B or above where accepted by KMMS.
gcse.sitting_policy: not separately scored in ApplySmart for KMMS
gcse.notes: Group A uses achieved GCSEs as the academic assessment input and must not require achieved A-levels.

grade_requirements.notes: Achieved AAB minimum for Group B. Must include Chemistry and/or Biology; if not both, the second science may be Physics, Maths, Psychology or Computer Science.

standard_offer.notes: Group B achieved minimum. Group A offers may be AAA or AAB by school average; offer prediction is out of scope.

contextual_offer.notes: Discounted offer only; not used for interview prediction.

a_level.third_subject_rules: Chemistry and/or Biology required; if not both Biology and Chemistry are offered, the second science may be Physics, Maths, Psychology or Computer Science. General Studies and Critical Thinking are not accepted.
a_level.notes: Predicted A-level grades are collected for general ApplySmart compatibility only and are ignored by KMMS academic and interview-selection logic.

grade_requirements.notes: Requires Chemistry or Biology at HL grade 6 plus a further HL science at grade 6.

ib.notes: Achieved IB only for Group B/post-IB applicants.

higher_offer.notes: Scottish applicants are generally Group C because KMMS cannot contextualise them in the English/Welsh school-data format.

advanced_higher_offer.notes: Advanced Higher AAB listed by MSC.

scottish.notes: Group C route; CASPer/manual-review handling preserved where ApplySmart lacks subjective scoring data.

access_to_he.notes: Accepted only for QAA Medicine-compliant Access routes and not within 3 years of sitting A-levels; provider verification is manual review.

degree.notes: Acceptable subjects include biosciences/biomedical/psychology and named health-profession degrees. Subject acceptability remains manual review unless already verified.

post_16.notes: Only achieved qualifications are used for KMMS interview selection.

ucat.notes: UCAT cognitive total is an official pass/fail Stage 2a gate. The 2026-entry threshold on the 900-2700 scale is not published and must not be derived from historical 3600-scale figures.

group_policies.notes: Groups A/B/C school-leaver and Group E school-leaver routes require Band 3 or better.
Group D and graduate-route applicants require Band 2 or better.

sjt.notes: Band 4 is an automatic rejection; graduates need Band 2 or better.

resits.notes: No additional executable resit scoring is represented for KMMS beyond the achieved qualification requirements.

english_language.notes: Applies where required, especially Group E/international equivalence routes.

age_or_professional_checks.notes: Professional checks are not interview-prediction scoring inputs.

ranking_factors.notes: Groups A/B are ranked by contextualised academic attainment relative to school averages; ApplySmart does not hold the required school-performance data.
UCAT is pass/fail only and is not ranked above the threshold.

total_score.notes: KMMS states it does not use percentage weighting. Group C/D/E scoring and CASPer/MMI scoring are not public and are not modelled.

calculation.notes: No academic+UCAT formula exists for KMMS.

selection_adjustments.notes: KMMS contextualises everyone in Groups A/B, using school-average GCSE or AAB+ performance data.

international_selection.notes: Do not pool Home and international applicants.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: Official KMMS runtime prediction remains unavailable while the 2026 UCAT threshold is null. ApplySmart advisory UCAT guidance is stored separately and cannot pass or reject an applicant.

criteria: KMPF or University of Kent/Canterbury Christ Church partner school or college
University of Kent or Canterbury Christ Church outreach activity
Currently in care or care-experienced within the last 6 years
adjustments: ABB discounted contextual offer where eligible
Contextualised academic ranking for Groups A/B
contextual_admissions.notes: Contextual offer adjustment is an offer-stage policy and does not create offer prediction.

ranking_pools.name: KMMS Home Groups A/B contextual ranking
ranking_factors: contextualised achieved GCSE or achieved post-16 attainment
ranking_pools.notes: Contextual school-performance data is not held by ApplySmart; official ranking outcome is manual review.

ranking_pools.name: KMMS Group C/D/E separate scoring
ranking_factors: manual review where subjective inputs are unavailable
ranking_pools.notes: Exact scoring formula is not published.

quotas.name: Verified Home/International places (2027 entry)
quotas.notes: Home/International place figures verified by the ApplySmart admissions research team for 2027 entry.
OfS Maximum Fundable Limit for medical Home places is 109 for 2025-26 onward unless changed.

offer_selection.interview_format: MMI: approximately six 7-minute stations plus a 40-45 minute group station for Home applicants; international MMIs may be remote with fewer short stations.
offer_selection.interview_scoring: Competency-based MMI scoring; exact numeric scoring and offer threshold are not published.
offer_selection.offer_model: Offers made by MMI performance in batches; offer prediction is out of scope.
offer_selection.waiting_list_policy: Offer, waiting list or reject after MMI; exact waiting-list thresholds are not modelled.

standard_offer.a_level: AAB for Group B minimum; Group A offer may be AAA or AAB by school average

contextual_offer.a_level: ABB where KMMS contextual-offer criteria are met

offer_selection.notes: No offer prediction has been introduced.

historical_admissions.notes: Historical UCAT figures are retained on the old 1200-3600 scale and must not be converted into the official runtime threshold.

validation.review_notes: Production profile replaces the previous MSC seed. Current official 2026 2700-scale UCAT threshold remains unavailable, so official runtime interview prediction is unavailable while advisory guidance is separate.

do_not_infer: Do not infer a 2026 2700-scale UCAT threshold.
Do not use predicted grades for KMMS.
Do not rank KMMS applicants by UCAT above threshold.
engine_notes.shared_engine_change: Generic opt-in a_level.predicted_grades_policy=ignore plus allow_unachieved_with_gcse_gate support, required so KMMS Group A applicants are not failed or scored using predicted A-levels.
engine_notes.predicted_grades_policy: Predicted grades may be collected but are ignored for KMMS academic eligibility, interview selection and advisory guidance.
engine_notes.production_scope: KMMS BM BS Medicine A100 only
